window.bar.title: Gearbook bar
window.library.title: Gearbook
window.settings.title: Gearbook settings
window.news.title: Gearbook: what is new
window.arrange.title: Gearbook: sort the game's list
arrange.intro: Sorts the game's own gearset list, not Gearbook's view of it. It only ever happens when you ask for it.
arrange.order.help: The same orders Gearbook offers in the library.
arrange.moves: {0} entries need moving. The ones that will move are highlighted.
arrange.apply.help: The order you have now is kept first. Every move is read back, and the first unexpected result stops the run.
arrange.restore.help: Returns the list to the order it was in before the last sort.
arrange.restore.none: Nothing kept yet, because nothing has been sorted yet.
arrange.result.nothing: Nothing to do, the list already read that way.
arrange.result.notLoggedIn: You have to be logged in for this.
arrange.result.unavailable: The game did not hand over its gearset list just now.
arrange.result.stopped: Stopped after {0} moves: an entry did not land where it was aimed. Nothing further was touched.
arrange.result.busy: Stopped after {0} moves because something else was going on. The list is partly sorted; just press again when you are finished.
arrange.undisturbed: Do nothing else while this runs: no crafting, no gathering, no combat, no cutscene. The game will not take a reordering then, and it does not say so.
library.empty: No gearsets found. Log in with a character that has some.
library.column.name: Name
library.detail.favourite.help: A favourite is what the bar shows. Marking one puts it there, and the arrows below decide where in the row it sits.
gearset.incomplete: A piece of this set is missing. The game will offer a suitable replacement when you put it on.
gearset.favouriteHint: Ctrl and right-click marks it as a favourite. Right-click on its own opens the menu.
library.detail.nothingSelected: Select a gearset to see its details.
library.selection.hint: Ctrl and click adds to the selection, shift and click takes a run.
library.bulk.heading: Change all of them
library.bulk.noteUntouched: Notes are left alone here. Forty of them cannot be put back.
library.duplicateWarning: Another gearset has the same job and the same name. The game cannot tell them apart either.
library.orphan.heading: Not currently present
library.orphan.explain: These notes and favourites belong to gearsets that are not in the list right now. Nothing was deleted, so if the set comes back its note comes back with it.
filter.heading: Filter
view.saveAs: Save the current filter as a view
view.nameTaken: A view of that name already exists.
sort.heading: Sort by
bar.view.tooltip: What the bar is showing. Click to change it.
bar.addHint: Mark gearsets as favourites, or add them to the bar from the library.
switch.blocked.inCombat: Not while you are in combat.
switch.blocked.notLoggedIn: Not while you are logged out.
switch.failed: The game refused the change. Nothing was equipped.
settings.language.help: Left on this, Gearbook speaks whatever language Dalamud is set to, and follows it when you change it. Pick a language here and that choice stays, whatever Dalamud does later.
settings.filterLevel.help: Only changes how much of the filter panel is on screen. Nothing is lost by choosing a smaller one; the views and tags you already made stay.
settings.bar.contents.help: Favourites keep the bar short enough to take in at a glance, which is the reason to have one. Putting all of them on it rebuilds the long list this was installed to avoid, but it is there for anybody who would rather not mark anything.
settings.bar.sort.help: Your own arrangement keeps every icon where you put it, which is what lets your hand find one without reading it. It only applies to the favourites, because every other view holds sets that were never arranged.
settings.bar.sort.manual: Keep my own arrangement of the favourites
settings.bar.sort.follows: Otherwise the bar takes the order set in the Gearbook library. Deliberately the same setting rather than a second one beside it: two controls answering the same question can disagree.
settings.bar.showItemLevel: Show the item level on the icon
settings.bar.highlightActive: Outline the set you are wearing
settings.bar.locked.help: A locked bar has no title bar and cannot be dragged, so it stays where you put it.
settings.bar.showViewSwitcher: Show the view switcher as the first icon
settings.bar.showOnStart: Show the bar when the plugin loads
settings.library.showGameNumber: Show the game's own gearset number
settings.library.showOrphans: Show notes whose gearset is missing
settings.library.warnDuplicates: Warn about gearsets sharing a job and a name
settings.roleOrder.help: Used when the list is sorted by role. Sorting by role is one entry in the sort control, so switching back to the game numbering is one click and changes nothing here.
settings.roleOrder.dragHint: Drag a row, or use the arrows.
settings.jobOrder: Order of the jobs within a role
settings.jobOrder.help: Applies inside a role only, because the role separates first: a healer can never end up among your tanks however you arrange the jobs. Used when sorting by role. Sorting by job alone stays alphabetical.
settings.bar.tools.help: Puts a button for Artisan and for Ice's Cosmic Exploration at the end of the bar, where they are installed and running. Artisan appears in the crafting views, Ice in crafting and gathering but only while you are standing in cosmic exploration content. Pressing one opens that plugin's own main window, and nothing else happens.
bar.tool.tooltip: Opens this plugin's own main window.
settings.jobOrder.empty: Once you have gearsets, the jobs they belong to appear here.
settings.news.autoOpen: Open the notes once after an update
settings.perCharacterNote: Every setting here belongs to this character alone.
settings.about.noAutomation: Gearbook never switches anything on its own. Every change is one you asked for.
news.empty: No release notes for this version.
bis.state.noAccount: Eorzea Arsenal is installed but no account is connected, so there is nothing to compare against.
bis.state.loading: Eorzea Arsenal is still loading its data.
bis.state.noData: Eorzea Arsenal has no best-in-slot targets set up yet.
command.help.main: Open Gearbook. Subcommands: bar, settings, news, view <name>, switch <name or number>.
command.switch.ambiguous: More than one gearset matches {0}. Use the number instead.
